records.source: I don't know you. Why are you talking to me?
records.translation: Hindi kita kilala. Bakit mo ako kinakausap?

records.source: Oh, is it my birthday? I was hoping I'd forget.#$b#This is actually really nice, though. Thank you.$h
records.translation: Ah, kaarawan ko ba? Umaasa akong makalimutan ko iyon.#$b#Pero talagang napakaganda nito. Salamat.$h

records.source: Oh, is it my birthday? That's right... I almost forgot. Thanks.
records.translation: Ah, kaarawan ko ba? Oo nga pala... Halos nakalimutan ko. Salamat.

records.source: I don't have to go into work today, so I'm not complaining...
records.translation: Hindi ko kailangang pumasok sa trabaho ngayon, kaya wala akong reklamo...

records.source: Oh, there's some kind of weird weather today? I didn't notice.
records.translation: Ah, may kakaibang panahon pala ngayon? Hindi ko napansin.

records.source: Heh... thanks. Tastes just like beer.
records.translation: Heh... salamat. Lasang-lasa itong serbesa.

records.source: Um... sure.#$e#I'd better stop eating...
records.translation: Um... sige.#$e#Dapat tumigil na akong kumain...

records.source: Oh, you made it? *squish*... Um... *smack*... I think I'll stick to frozen pizza. But thanks.
records.translation: Ah, ikaw ang gumawa nito? *pisak*... Um... *ngasab*... Sa tingin ko, sa nakapirming pizza na lang ako. Pero salamat.

records.source: Have you tried the new Joja Bubblerito? I ate two in one sitting yesterday, that was a mistake...
records.translation: Nasubukan mo na ba ang bagong Joja Bubblerito? Dalawa ang kinain ko nang tuloy-tuloy kahapon, malaking pagkakamali iyon...

records.source: I... wasn't really expecting this, after all I've put you through...
records.translation: Hindi ko... talaga inaasahan ito, matapos ang lahat ng ipinagdaanan mo dahil sa akin...

records.source: I think I might be the luckiest guy in the world... $h
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, baka ako na ang pinakamasuwerteng lalaki sa mundo... $h

records.source: Sorry you had to see me like that, @...$s
records.translation: Pasensiya ka na at nakita mo akong ganoon, @...$s

records.source: I'm trying to cut back on the drinks... it's not going to be easy.
records.translation: Sinisikap kong bawasan ang pag-inom... hindi ito magiging madali.

records.source: Buh... hope the bar's open.
records.translation: Bleh... sana bukas ang bar.

records.source: Welp... got my year's supply of Vitamin D. Now I can play video games with the blinds shut the rest of the year.
records.translation: Ayan... nakuha ko na ang sapat na Bitamina D para sa buong taon. Puwede na akong maglaro ng mga video game nang nakasara ang mga persiyana sa natitirang bahagi ng taon.

records.source: That's right... I'm not wearing any shoes or socks.#$b#Some call it a public health risk.#$b#The crabs seem to enjoy it, though.$h
records.translation: Tama... wala akong suot na sapatos o medyas.#$b#Itinuturing ito ng ilan na panganib sa pampublikong kalusugan.#$b#Pero mukhang natutuwa naman ang mga alimango.$h

records.source: Hoo... Feels good to rest these hams.#$b#If anyone needs me, I'll just be sitting here, marinating.
records.translation: Hoo... Ang sarap ipahinga ng mga hitang ito.#$b#Kung may mangailangan sa akin, nakaupo lang ako rito at nagbababad.

records.source: Phew... feels good to have a cold drink...#$e#Or maybe a few...
records.translation: Hay... ang sarap ng malamig na inumin...#$e#O baka ilang malamig na inumin...

records.source: Okay, this sand is piping hot. I regret not wearing shoes.$s
records.translation: Sige, napakainit ng buhanging ito. Pinagsisisihan kong hindi ako nagsapatos.$s

records.source: Dance? Hoo-boy. Okay... let me chug a few more of these first...
records.translation: Sayaw? Naku po. Sige... lagukin ko lang muna ang ilan pa sa mga ito...
...Ayoko.$s

records.source: I heard you built Pam a house... That's really generous...#$b#You know, I could use a hundred thousand gold myself...#$e#*ahem* ...ah ...Just kidding. ...Heh.
records.translation: Narinig kong ipinagtayo mo ng bahay si Pam... Napakabukas-palad mo...#$b#Alam mo, magagamit ko rin ang sandaang libong ginto...#$e#*ahem* ...ah... Nagbibiro lang. ...Heh.

records.source: I heard someone bought Pam a house... *sigh*... What did Pam ever do to earn that kind of generosity??
records.translation: Narinig kong may bumili ng bahay para kay Pam... *buntong-hininga*... Ano ba ang ginawa ni Pam para maging karapat-dapat sa ganoong kabukas-palad na regalo??

records.source: ...$a#$e#...Leave me alone.$a
records.translation: ...$a#$e#...Pabayaan mo ako.$a

records.source: *gulp* Oh... Yeah, okay... I guess I should've seen this coming.$s#$b#I'll... uh... guess I'll see you at the Saloon.
records.translation: *lagok* Ah... Oo, sige... Dapat siguro inasahan ko na ito.$s#$b#Siguro... uh... magkikita na lang tayo sa Stardrop Saloon.

records.source: %Shane has a glazed look in his eye. He won't speak to you.
records.translation: %Tulalang nakatingin si Shane. Ayaw ka niyang kausapin.

records.source: I don't understand you... *sigh*...
records.translation: Hindi kita maintindihan... *buntong-hininga*...

records.source: I hardly know you. Why are you talking to me?||What's the point of talking to me? I don't want any friends.
records.translation: Halos hindi kita kilala. Bakit mo ako kinakausap?||Ano ang saysay ng pakikipag-usap sa akin? Ayaw kong magkaroon ng kaibigan.

records.source: Hey. Sorry if I came off as rude when we first met.#$e#It takes me a while to warm up to strangers.||It's a lot of effort to be friends with someone. It's easier to just be alone.
records.translation: Uy. Pasensiya na kung naging bastos ako noong una tayong nagkita.#$e#Matagal bago ako maging palagay sa mga estranghero.||Napakahirap makipagkaibigan sa isang tao. Mas madaling mag-isa na lang.

records.source: I'll be honest, I still can't understand why you'd want to be friends with me.||Life isn't fair, and I can't help but feel bitter about it.
records.translation: Magiging tapat ako, hindi ko pa rin maintindihan kung bakit gusto mong makipagkaibigan sa akin.||Hindi patas ang buhay, at hindi ko mapigilang sumama ang loob ko dahil dito.

records.source: Do you ever feel like the whole world is scrutinizing you like some disgusting insect?
records.translation: Naramdaman mo na bang sinusuri ka ng buong mundo na para kang nakakadiring insekto?

records.source: What? What do you want? Go away.
records.translation: Ano? Ano ang gusto mo? Umalis ka.

records.source: What do you want from me? Money? I'd give you a pot of gold to leave me alone!
records.translation: Ano ang gusto mo sa akin? Pera? Bibigyan kita ng isang palayok ng ginto para lang pabayaan mo ako!

records.source: Every time I try something new it goes horribly wrong. You learn to just stay in a shell.
records.translation: Sa tuwing sumusubok ako ng bago, napakasama ng kinakalabasan. Natututo ka na lang magkulong sa sarili mong mundo.

records.source: Life isn't so bad... at least I have frozen pizza and eggs.$u
records.translation: Hindi naman ganoon kasama ang buhay... kahit papaano, may nakapirming pizza at mga itlog ako.$u

records.source: We should go to a Tunnelers game some time. When I go by myself, I usually drink way too much beer.
records.translation: Dapat minsan ay manood tayo ng laro ng Tunnelers. Kapag mag-isa akong pumupunta, karaniwan ay napaparami ang inom ko ng serbesa.

records.source: I need to keep it together for Jas' sake. I don't want to be a bad role model for her.||I'm kind of like a father figure to Jas. I just hope I haven't let her down too much.$s
records.translation: Kailangan kong ayusin ang sarili ko para kay Jas. Ayaw kong maging masamang huwaran para sa kanya.||Para na rin akong ama ni Jas. Sana hindi ko siya masyadong binigo.$s

records.source: No, I don't have time to chat with you.
records.translation: Hindi, wala akong oras para makipagkuwentuhan sa iyo.

records.source: I guess I've grown attached to Marnie and Jas. We're a ragtag bunch but it kind of feels like a weird family.#$e#I never really had much of a family as a kid.$s
records.translation: Sa palagay ko, napamahal na sa akin sina Marnie at Jas. Magulo kaming grupo pero parang kakaiba kaming pamilya.#$e#Halos wala akong naging pamilya noong bata ako.$s

records.source: $d Joja#*sigh* ...Every day is the same. Stocking those horrible shelves, going to the saloon, tossing and turning all night.$s|I hated my job at JojaMart, but now that I'm unemployed I feel even worse.$s
records.translation: $d Joja#*buntong-hininga* ...Pare-pareho lang ang bawat araw. Naglalagay ng paninda sa kasuklam-suklam na mga estante, pumupunta sa Stardrop Saloon, at hindi mapakali buong gabi.$s|Kinasusuklaman ko ang trabaho ko sa JojaMart, pero ngayong wala akong trabaho ay mas masama pa ang pakiramdam ko.$s

records.source: What do you want? Leave me alone.
records.translation: Ano ang gusto mo? Pabayaan mo ako.

records.source: You're really persistent. I guess I'm just surprised that anyone would be interested in talking to me.
records.translation: Napakatiyaga mo talaga. Siguro nagulat lang ako na may sinumang interesadong makipag-usap sa akin.

records.source: Buh... Where's the Joja Cola?||Why try? Life's just a roll of the dice.#$e#When they rolled mine, the dice fell off the table.
records.translation: Bleh... Nasaan ang Joja Cola?||Bakit pa susubok? Parang rolyo lang ng dais ang buhay.#$e#Nang nirolyo ang para sa akin, nahulog ang dais sa mesa.

records.source: You like talking to me? I guess I believe you... maybe you're as weird as I am.$h
records.translation: Gusto mo akong kausap? Siguro naniniwala ako sa iyo... baka pareho lang tayong kakaiba.$h

records.source: Don't you have work to do?
records.translation: Wala ka bang trabahong dapat gawin?

records.source: %Shane's hard at work. He doesn't seem interested in talking.
records.translation: %Abalang-abala si Shane sa trabaho. Mukhang ayaw niyang makipag-usap.

records.source: $d Joja#What's the point of life if all you do is work?|I haven't been able to pay my rent, but Marnie's letting me stay anyway. I'm lucky.
records.translation: $d Joja#Ano ang saysay ng buhay kung puro trabaho lang ang ginagawa mo?|Hindi ko mabayaran ang upa ko, pero hinahayaan pa rin ako ni Marnie na manatili. Masuwerte ako.

records.source: I'll definitely be going to the saloon tonight. What else is there to do?
records.translation: Tiyak na pupunta ako sa Stardrop Saloon ngayong gabi. Ano pa ba ang magagawa?

records.source: Buh... Can you imagine how disgusting my liver must look?$s#$e#My body feels twenty years older than it should...$s
records.translation: Bleh... Naiisip mo ba kung gaano na kasagwa ang hitsura ng atay ko?$s#$e#Pakiramdam ko, mas matanda nang dalawampung taon ang katawan ko kaysa sa tunay kong edad...$s

records.source: My body hurts a lot less since I cut back on the booze.#$e#But it still feels like I'm always teetering on the edge...$s
records.translation: Di-hamak na hindi na gaanong masakit ang katawan ko mula nang bawasan ko ang alak.#$e#Pero parang lagi pa rin akong nanganganib na mahulog sa bingit...$s

records.source: Why are you bothering me? I want to be alone.
records.translation: Bakit mo ako ginugulo? Gusto kong mapag-isa.

records.source: #$1 ShaneJOSH#I'm surprised that you're still trying to make friends with me. Haven't I been rude enough to you yet?#$e#*sigh*...$s
records.translation: #$1 ShaneJOSH#Nagulat akong sinusubukan mo pa ring makipagkaibigan sa akin. Hindi pa ba sapat ang pagiging bastos ko sa iyo?#$e#*buntong-hininga*...$s

records.source: $d Joja#I'm renting my room from Marnie at a really good price. It's small but I can't complain.|If I could reset my life maybe I'd start a chicken farm. Only free-range eggs of course.
records.translation: $d Joja#Inuupahan ko ang kuwarto ko kay Marnie sa napakababang halaga. Maliit ito pero hindi ako makapagreklamo.|Kung maibabalik ko sa simula ang buhay ko, baka magsimula ako ng bukid ng mga manok. Siyempre, mga itlog lang mula sa mga manok na malayang gumagala.

records.source: I've really grown attached to Marnie's chickens.$h||A chicken will never let you down. Humans, on the other hand...
records.translation: Talagang napamahal na sa akin ang mga manok ni Marnie.$h||Hindi ka kailanman bibiguin ng manok. Pero ang mga tao...

records.source: Your farm seems like a great place to raise chickens.$h
records.translation: Mukhang napakagandang lugar ang bukid mo para mag-alaga ng mga manok.$h

records.source: I'm busy, can't you tell?||...I don't feel like talking to anyone.
records.translation: Abala ako, hindi mo ba nakikita?||...Wala akong ganang makipag-usap kaninuman.

records.source: You again? How many times do I have to tell you to leave me alone?$s
records.translation: Ikaw na naman? Ilang beses ko bang kailangang sabihing pabayaan mo ako?$s

records.source: Hmm... it's %time. Should I throw a frozen pizza in the microwave, or should I wait?$u||If the Tunnelers win, I'll knock back a cold one to celebrate.#$e#If they lose? I'll have a cold one to drown my sorrows.
records.translation: Hmm... %time na. Ilalagay ko na ba sa microwave ang nakapirming pizza, o maghihintay pa ako?$u||Kapag nanalo ang Tunnelers, lalagok ako ng malamig na serbesa para magdiwang.#$e#Kapag natalo sila? Iinom ako para lunurin ang lungkot ko.

records.source: ...I think I might be gaining weight.$s
records.translation: ...Sa tingin ko, baka tumataba ako.$s

records.source: If I watch more TV maybe I can forget about life. That would be relaxing.$u
records.translation: Baka makalimutan ko ang buhay kung manonood pa ako ng telebisyon. Nakakarelaks siguro iyon.$u

records.source: Hi, @. I've actually been having a pretty good day so far.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Maganda-ganda talaga ang araw ko hanggang ngayon.$h

records.source: Okay... that'll require a great script. Maybe I'll ask Elliott for advice next time I see him at the saloon.$s
records.translation: Sige... mangangailangan iyan ng napakagandang iskrip. Baka humingi ako ng payo kay Elliott sa susunod na makita ko siya sa Stardrop Saloon.$s

records.source: Sounds great. I'll have to create a bunch of practical effects to make it look cool.
records.translation: Maganda iyan. Kakailanganin kong gumawa ng maraming praktikal na special effect para maging kahanga-hanga ang hitsura nito.

records.source: I didn't know you were such a miser...$s
records.translation: Hindi ko alam na napakakuripot mo pala...$s

records.source: Okay, Dad...$s^Okay, Mom...$s
records.translation: Sige, Tay...$s^Sige, Nay...$s

records.source: Oh, wow...$s
records.translation: Ah, grabe...$s

records.source: ...Yeah, me too.
records.translation: ...Oo, ako rin.

records.source: I know... that's why I stopped by, to tell you about it.
records.translation: Alam ko... kaya ako dumaan, para sabihin sa iyo ang tungkol dito.

records.source: Wow, it was that serious, huh? I can hardly remember...
records.translation: Grabe, ganoon pala iyon kaseryoso? Halos hindi ko na maalala...

records.source: Oh yeah? I guess that makes sense.$6#$b#Me? I get bored with Pelican Town sometimes.#$b#But... I like that you're different. We balance each other out.$l
records.translation: Ah, talaga? May katwiran naman iyon.$6#$b#Ako? Nababagot ako minsan sa Bayan ng Pelican.#$b#Pero... gusto kong naiiba ka. Napupunan natin ang kakulangan ng isa’t isa.$l

records.source: Oh really? I'm surprised... Didn't you move to Stardew Valley to escape the noise of the city?$6#$b#I mean... Don't get me wrong, I totally understand. My life in Pelican Town is pretty bland, you know.
records.translation: Talaga? Nagulat ako... Hindi ka ba lumipat sa Stardew Valley para takasan ang ingay ng lungsod?$6#$b#Ang ibig kong sabihin... Huwag kang magkamali ng intindi, naiintindihan kita. Medyo walang sigla ang buhay ko sa Bayan ng Pelican, alam mo.
